home.title: Hello, I'm Adwil Castillo
home.subtitle: Software Engineer based in Santiago, Dominican Republic
home.p1: Friendly and professional software engineer with a passion for web development and design. I'm always looking to learn new technologies and improve my skills, so I'm open to new opportunities and challenges. I'm currently working as a full-stack developer using a wide range of technologies, from web development using JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, and Vue.js, to mobile development using React Native. I've also worked with Node.js, Express.js, and Nest.js for backend development, and SQL databases such as MySQL and SQL Server.
home.p2: I'm a proactive and self-motivated person who enjoys working in a team and collaborating with others to achieve common goals. I'm also a creative thinker who loves to solve problems and come up with innovative solutions that allow me to grow both personally and professionally. If you're looking for a dedicated software engineer to join your team, I'd love to hear from you!
